title: User API errors during morning peak
executive_summary: User API errors during the morning peak (INC-009) began at 07:57-08:00Z, coinciding with the user-service 7.1.3 -> 7.2.0 deployment at 07:56Z (switch ORM to batch loader). user-service error rate rose from ~0.4% to ~23% and api-gateway 5xx rose from ~0.5% to ~7.8%. Logs show a NullPointerException in ProfileBatchLoader.load on v7.2.0 starting 07:57:17Z, consistent with the deployment as the cause. Latency, DB connection utilization, timeouts and request rate were flat, so this is not a capacity or traffic problem.

hypotheses.description: Regression in user-service v7.2.0 (ORM batch loader change) causes NullPointerException in ProfileBatchLoader.load, producing HTTP 500s that api-gateway surfaces to users. Mechanism: Deployment at 07:56Z introduces batch loader; some requests hit a null in ProfileBatchLoader.load, throwing NPE and returning 500. user-service error rate jumps at 07:57-08:00; api-gateway error rate follows at 08:00 as it proxies the 500s.
